# Aspen Sojourner

> > Aspen Sojourner is the premier guide to fine dining, restaurants, and culinary experiences in Aspen, Snowmass Village, and the surrounding Colorado mountain communities.

The site features comprehensive coverage of Aspen's upscale dining scene, from award-winning restaurants like Element 47 at The Little Nell to unique on-mountain experiences at Cloud Nine Alpine Bistro. Content includes restaurant profiles, culinary producers, and local dining guides that showcase the region's world-class gastronomy.

## Key Topics

- Aspen fine dining
- Colorado mountain restaurants
- CP Restaurant Group
- Element 47
- The Little Nell
- Wine Spectator awards
- On-mountain dining
- Cloud Nine Alpine Bistro
- Snowmass Village dining
- New American cuisine
- Alpine bistros
- Aspen Highlands
- Local culinary landmarks
- Upscale Colorado cuisine
- Independent restaurants

## Featured Restaurants & Dining

- [Element 47](https://www.aspensojo.com/businesses/element-47): Element 47 fine dining at The Little Nell with Wine Spectator cellar
- [Cloud Nine Alpine Bistro](https://www.aspensojo.com/businesses/cloud-nine-alpine-bistro): Cloud Nine Alpine Bistro on-mountain dining at Aspen Highlands
- [The Artisan](https://www.aspensojo.com/businesses/the-artisan): The Artisan at Stonebridge Inn offering seasonal Snowmass dining
